1. (Currently amended) A catheter system for delivering ultrasonic energy to a treatment site within a body lumen, the catheter comprising: a tubular body having a proximal end, a distal end and an energy delivery section positioned between the proximal end and the distal end; a plurality of ultrasound radiating members positioned within the energy delivery section, the plurality of ultrasound radiating members being allocated into electrical groups comprising more than one ultrasound radiating member; wherein the ultrasound radiating members of one electrical group are spatially interdigitated with the ultrasound radiating members of another electrical group; and __at least one therapeutic compound delivery lumen that extends through the tubular body and terminates at at least one outlet positioned in the energy delivery section__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Currently amended) The catheter system of Claim 1, wherein the ultrasound radiating members are interdigitated in a regular pattern __along a longitudinal axis of the tubular body__.

5. (Currently amended) The catheter system of Claim 1, wherein the ultrasound radiating members are interdigitated in a pseudo random pattern __along a longitudinal axis of the tubular body__.

6. (Currently amended) A system for treating a patient having pulmonary embolism, the system comprising: first and second ultrasound catheters, each of the first and second ultrasound catheters comprising a tubular body having a proximal portion and a distal portion, the distal portion comprising an ultrasound energy delivery section having at least one ultrasound element, the tubular body also including at least one fluid delivery lumen, and __an elongate inner core carrying the at least one ultrasound element__; and a control system __connected to and configured to operate both the elongate inner core of the first ultrasound catheter and the elongate inner core of the second ultrasound catheter__.

7. (Currently amended) The system of Claim 6, wherein the control system operates both the [[first and the second elongate inner cores]] __elongate inner core of the first ultrasound catheter and the elongate inner core of the second ultrasound catheter__ simultaneously.

8. (Currently amended) The system of Claim 7, wherein the control system is configured to independently control the ultrasound radiating members on the [[first and the second elongate inner cores]] __elongate inner core of the first ultrasound catheter and the elongate inner core of the second ultrasound catheter__.

9. (Currently amended) A method for treating a patient having pulmonary embolism, the method comprising: advancing an ultrasound catheter comprising an tubular body having a proximal portion and a distal portion, the distal portion comprising an ultrasound energy delivery section comprising at least one ultrasound element and at least one fluid delivery lumen; advancing the distal portion of the ultrasound catheter to a treatment site in the patient's pulmonary artery; inflating a balloon on the distal portion of the ultrasound catheter; delivering a thrombolytic drug to the treatment site through the at least one fluid delivery lumen; and emitting ultrasonic energy to thereby promote diffusion of the thrombolytic drug at the treatment site, __wherein the ultrasound catheter comprises a guidewire lumen extending through the proximal portion and the ultrasound energy delivery section__.

10. (Previously presented) The method of Claim 9, wherein delivering the thrombolytic drug and emitting ultrasonic energy are performed simultaneously.

11. (Currently amended) An ultrasound catheter for treating a patient having pulmonary embolism, the catheter comprising an tubular body having a proximal portion and a distal portion, the distal portion comprising an ultrasound energy delivery section comprising at least one ultrasound element and at least one fluid delivery lumen, the tubular body defining a guidewire lumen extending through the proximal portion and the ultrasound energy delivery section, __wherein the ultrasound catheter further comprises at least one balloon positioned at the distal portion of the ultrasound catheter__.

12. (Previously presented) The ultrasound catheter of Claim 11, wherein the guidewire lumen extends through the at least one ultrasound element.

13. (Cancelled)
